pt-in标记的新施与刷新，不修改已有印或tick相位。","平均保护为B+P×max(0,x−B)，P是敌方施印落在澄明窗口的比例。B=.24、x=.30、P=.5时=.27；无来印就没有这份收益，不计入无条件承伤点或标准秒伤。","图签上方是被截短的火焰，下方是清澈菱晶与小人，表示消印后保护主人。只用共享状态与原缓存，不新增战场光圈、粒子或逐击实体。"],"placement":{"contentPackId":"base-returning-sword","categoryPath":["weapons","atlas-s21","effects","attributes"],"scope":"exclusive","owner":{"kind":"weapon","id":"atlas-s21","name":"淬虹"}},"provenance":{"sourcePaths":["assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s21/effects/attributes/affix.cuihong-quench-clarity/effect.pack.ts","assets/packs/content/base-returning-sword/weapons/atlas-s21/effects/attributes/affix.cuihong-quench-clarity/item-affix.pack.ts","src/combat/sword-contact-status.ts","src/combat/status-contact-source.ts","src/combat/stats.ts","docs/design/proposals/SIX-SWORD-SUFFIX-CLOSEOUT.md"],"legacyNodeIds":[]}}}
